prompt:
Subject:
Laughter spilling out on the veranda

Main character:
A woman in her 20s bending forward deeply from the waist by the side of a wooden house veranda, laughing while covering her mouth with one hand. Place the upper body largely horizontally from the center to the right of the screen, depicting a white dress with light blue small floral patterns, and a hand stretched to the wall.

Person/Expression:
Rounded cheeks, small nose, eyes closed laughing. Face directed to the bottom right of the screen, covering the mouth with the person's own left hand, a big smile with raised cheeks. Dark brown hair gathered into two small buns on the left and right, leaving thin bangs and thin stray hairs falling on the cheeks.

Clothing/Pose:
A short frill dress with thin shoulder straps and small light blue floral patterns on a white background. Make clear the thin ribbon tied at the back, the relaxed upper body, and the two-tiered waving hem. Standing bent forward nearly at a right angle from the waist. Left elbow bent covering the mouth with the left hand. The person's own right arm extended diagonally upward, placing the right palm on a white wall to support the body.

Background/Light:
White plaster wall, wooden frame sliding door and veranda on the right of the screen, tiled roof building, green trees, gravel and stepping stone garden in the back left. Direct warm sunlight from the upper left of the screen, brightly illuminating the back, arms, legs, and floral cloth, creating a long shadow towards the veranda side.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4. Portrait above the thighs with a horizontal camera at waist height. Place the person's waist in the left half, the face and the hand covering the mouth in the center right, and the right hand placed on the wall in the upper right. Capture the legs at the bottom edge and right fingers near the right edge. Focus on the face and both hands, with shallow depth of field softly blurring the garden.

Texture/Style:
Photoreal live-action photo taken with warm summer natural light. High-definition depiction of thin floral cloth, wood and plaster, skin light, stray hairs, and gravel garden.

Negative:
Change in the left hand covering the mouth and the right hand supporting the wall; weakening of the deep forward leaning posture
